title: Sharp Minimax Theory for Randomized Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2608.13822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study minimax-optimal designs and estimators for estimating the sample average treatment effect in finite population randomized experiments, where both design and estimator are unrestricted. For binary potential outcomes, we show this minimax risk is equivalent to the minimax risk $\rho_n^*$ of an estimation problem with $2$ unknown parameters. We leverage this reduction to establish a second-order risk expansion $\rho_n^* = n^{-1} - Cn^{-4/3} + o_n(n^{-4/3})$ for an explicit constant $C$ related to the Airy function. The minimax risk is attained by Bernoulli randomization with a nonlinear shrinkage estimator. Our results show that standard procedures such as complete randomization with difference in means are only minimax optimal up to first order in $n.$ We derive further results on admissibility of these procedures and discuss the practical implications of our results.

translated_title: 随机实验的尖锐极小极大理论
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13822v1 公告类型：交叉摘要：我们研究了有限总体随机实验中估计样本平均处理效应的极小极大最优设计和估计量，其中设计和估计量均不受限制。对于二元潜在结果，我们证明了该极小极大风险等价于一个具有2个未知参数的估计问题的极小极大风险$\rho_n^*$。我们利用这一简化建立了二阶风险展开式$\rho_n^* = n^{-1} - Cn^{-4/3} + o_n(n^{-4/3})$，其中显式常数$C$与艾里函数相关。极小极大风险通过伯努利随机化结合非线性收缩估计量达到。我们的结果表明，标准程序如完全随机化与均值差估计仅在$n$的一阶意义上达到极小极大最优。我们进一步推导了这些程序的可采纳性结果，并讨论了其实际意义。
tldr: 本文证明了二元结果下随机实验的极小极大风险具有二阶展开，并表明伯努利随机化与非线性收缩估计量能达到最优，而标准方法仅一阶最优。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a second-order minimax risk expansion for randomized experiments with binary outcomes, showing Bernoulli randomization with nonlinear shrinkage achieves optimality while standard methods are only first-order optimal.
